events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art began on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York, on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary festival, what was your favourite performance from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee, on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today. His music and charisma continue to captivate generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce songwriting with The Pretenders have left an indelible mark on rock music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher, known for his distinctive vocal style and outspoken personality, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo success, he's still a rock 'n' roll star.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and sixty-four years of cinematic espionage. What's your top Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Silly Walks & Laughter
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python's silly walks to Fawlty Towers' chaos, he's a true British comedy icon.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Showman
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
